title: Junior Data Administrator
description:
Junior Data Administrator

Location: Greater Manchester

Salary: 25,000 - 28,000

Working Pattern: Fully Office Based

We're working with a growing ecommerce and retail business that's looking for a Junior Data Administrator to join its Data & Analytics function.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone at the beginning of their data career who wants to gain hands-on commercial experience while working directly with an experienced Head of Data.

You'll play an important role in ensuring the business has accurate and reliable data, with a particular focus on stock, orders and operational information.

The Role

You'll be responsible for:
- Managing and maintaining stock and order data
- Checking data quality and investigating discrepancies
- Producing and maintaining regular reports
- Working with Excel and internal business systems
- Ensuring information is accurate and up to date
- Supporting teams across the business with data queries
- Working directly with the Head of Data on wider reporting and data projects
- Helping improve existing data processes as the business continues to grow

What We're Looking For

We're not looking for years of commercial experience. This could suit a recent graduate or someone with some initial experience in Data, Administration, Reporting, Ecommerce or a similar position.

You'll ideally have:
- Strong Excel skills
- Good attention to detail
- Confidence working with numbers and large amounts of information
- An analytical mindset and ability to spot inconsistencies
- Strong communication and organisational skills
- An interest in developing a career within Data & Analytics

Experience with ecommerce, stock or order data would be advantageous but isn't essential

What's On Offer?

Salary of 25,000 - 28,000 plus the opportunity to join a growing business where you'll work closely with the Head of Data and gain exposure to the wider Data & Analytics function.

If you're early in your career and looking for an opportunity to build genuine commercial data experience, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Scheduling Coordinator
description:
Scheduling Coordinator

Location: Altrincham
Salary: £30,000 £32,000
Hours: 37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday (9am - 5:30pm)
Job Type: Permanent

We are currently recruiting for an experienced Scheduling Coordinator to join a busy and growing operations team based in Altrincham.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a strong background in scheduling, coordination, dispatch or logistics, ideally within a technical, engineering or field-service environment.

You will play a key role in coordinating a team of engineers, ensuring visits are scheduled efficiently, customers are kept informed and engineers have everything they need to complete their work successfully.

The role would suit someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, is highly organised and enjoys problem-solving when priorities change throughout the day.

Key Responsibilities
- Plan and coordinate engineer schedules for installations, service visits, repairs and urgent callouts.
- Manage daily, weekly and monthly schedules, balancing workloads and engineer availability.
- Monitor live schedules and respond quickly to cancellations, delays, changing customer requirements and urgent requests.
- Maintain accurate job and scheduling information within Salesforce and internal systems.
- Coordinate with engineers to ensure they have the correct job information, site instructions, documentation and customer requirements.
- Track engineer movements and job progress, proactively identifying and escalating potential delays.
- Liaise with internal teams including Projects, Operations, Service Desk, Account Management and Finance.
- Act as a key point of contact for customers regarding scheduled visits and provide updates where arrangements change.
- Prepare and manage permits and RAMS documentation, ensuring information is accurate and compliant.
- Arrange accommodation and travel requirements for engineers where necessary.
- Review monthly timesheet information and investigate any discrepancies.
- Process fixed penalty fees where required.
- Maintain scheduling records, databases and reports.
- Support the wider team with identifying opportunities to improve scheduling and field-service processes.

About You

We are looking for someone who has previous experience in a scheduling, coordination, dispatch or logistics role, ideally where you have been responsible for managing multiple engineers, technicians, contractors or field-based employees.

You will ideally have:
- Proven experience working within a scheduling or coordination environment.
- Hands-on experience using Salesforce
- Excellent organisational and time-management skills.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Confident communication skills, both written and verbal.
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and remain calm under pressure.
- Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach.
- Experience working with scheduling, tracking or operational systems.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office.
- The ability to work independently while also being a strong team player.

Desirable Experience

Experience within a technical, engineering, installation, field service or project environment would be advantageous. Knowledge of permits, RAMS, compliance documentation or engineer site requirements would also be beneficial, although full training can be provided to the right candidate.

What's On Offer?
- Salary of £30,000 £32,000
- Monday to Friday, 37.5 hours per week
- Based in Altrincham
- Permanent position
- Opportunity to join a busy and established operations team
- Varied role with plenty of responsibility and opportunity to make an impact

title: Mortgage Customer Service Advisor CeMAP Study Support
company: Connections The Recruitment Specialists - Agency - Permanent
description:
We're looking for a Mortgage Customer Service Advisor to join a specialist team supporting mortgage advisers across a growing network.

This is a great opportunity for someone with strong customer service or administration experience who is interested in building a career within mortgages and financial services.

You don't need previous mortgage experience or CeMAP. Full training will be provided, with CeMAP study support available as you develop.

You'll be supporting mortgage advisers with queries around products, lenders, processes and systems, helping them find the information they need and providing a high level of service.

This is a non-sales role.

The Role
- Provide first-line support to mortgage advisers across the network
- Respond to queries around mortgage products, lenders, criteria and processes
- Help advisers navigate mortgage research and quotation systems
- Provide accurate information and practical support to help advisers progress applications
- Handle queries confidently and professionally, keeping a strong focus on customer outcomes
- Build strong working relationships with mortgage advisers and internal teams
- Keep up to date with changes across the mortgage market and lender criteria
- Maintain accurate records and ensure queries are followed through to resolution
- Share feedback and ideas to help improve processes and the service provided

You'll ideally have:
- Experience in customer service, administration or a similar role
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
- A confident and professional telephone manner
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities
- A proactive approach to problem solving
- The ability to learn technical information and apply it confidently
- Good attention to detail
- A genuine interest in developing a career within mortgages and financial services

Previous mortgage, banking, financial services or property experience would be advantageous but isn't essential.

Training & Qualifications

The business will provide full training and support towards CeMAP as you develop within the role.

You'll have the opportunity to build your technical mortgage knowledge while gaining hands-on experience working closely with experienced mortgage advisers.

For someone looking to build a long-term career in mortgages, this provides a strong route into the industry without needing to already hold CeMAP.

What's on offer?
- Full training from experienced mortgage professionals
- CeMAP study support
- Clear development opportunities within mortgages and financial services
- Exposure to mortgage products, lenders and the application process
- Supportive team environment
- Opportunity to work closely with experienced mortgage advisers
- A role combining customer service, technical knowledge and financial services

title: Team Administrator

advertiser_name: Cheshire and Wirral Partnership NHS Foundation Trust
description: An exciting opportunity has arisen for a new team administrator role to join the existing team in CWP Adult Eating Disorders Service; 0.4, 15 hours per week over 2 days WTE Team Administrator in Stockport, based at Hall Lodge Eating Disorders Service. The successful candidate will provide a high quality supportive role to clients living with an Eating Disorder. In Stockport Eating Disorders Service we consider our admin team key to the ability of our clinicians to support our patients. They are a valued part of our structure. You will receivemonthly high quality supervision to support people in their role and career aspirations. We try very hard to understand the difficulties and pressures working for an admin team within a complex clinical area like eating disorders. We also offer a monthly business meeting as an arena to discuss with our team anything that will improve our service . Within the team you will be working alongside an experienced administrator who will support you in your role and a group of friendly clinicians who have lots of experience working with this group of patients. The successful candidate will bring an organised and compassionate approach to their working life. The Trust currently supports the Real Living Wage (RLW) hourly rate as set by the Living Wage Federation and will apply a pay supplement if the national A4C hourly rate falls below this. The role will also involve administrative duties such as electronic filing and updating electronic patient records, monitoring the service email inbox, responding to emails, sending out and receiving letters, taking meeting minutes, dictation, organising appointments and utilising excel spreadsheets, using the printer/scanner. Please see the job description for greater detail on this.The main attributes we will be looking for in a candidate will be an ability to be welcoming to service users, and to handle often distressed and distressing conversations with service users and families. We are looking for someone who is organised and trustworthy who is able to underpin the work of our clinicians. Gathering information from phone calls or emails and passing it on in a reliable prompt way. title: Medical Receptionist/ Care Navigator
description: This is an exciting career opportunity for a Part-Time Medical Receptionist (Care Navigators) to join a friendly, four partner training practice serving around 9000 patients in the ever-popular suburb of Sale, South Manchester. We are looking for friendly, helpful, enthusiastic people to join our busy team. We have excellent staff retainment. We are advertising due to retirement. Permanent vacancy for 20 hours per week Working week is based on a two week rota: Week 1 Mon - 8.00-12.30 Wed - 13.00-18.30 Thu - 8.00-1.00 Fri - 8.00-1.00 Week 2 Wed - 13.00-18.00 Thu - 13.00-18.00 Fri - 13.00-18.00 Previous Experience of Medical Reception is desirable but not essential. A background of administration and/or customer service would also be considered. MEDICAL RECEPTIONIST JOB DESCRIPTION RECEPTION DESK Welcoming patients into the Surgery Checking them in on screen (or advising to use self- check in) Accepting samples and directing them to correct person/ collection Accepting deliveries/ informing relevant department. Accepting new registrations, completing relevant paperwork Accepting and booking travel immunisation APTS. Ensuring reception well stocked with sample pots/ forms/ registration packs. Answering telephone queries/appointments when necessary. (will only be necessary when only 3 or less members of staff on duty. PRESCRIPTIONS Processing of prescriptions received from pharmacies, online requests, and hand-written requests from prescription box. Processing appliance requests from Bullen/Ainsworth/Charter etc. Making sure all medications queries are passed to either a GP or medicines management for clarification. Directing hospital and other agency letters sent via the prescription email are passed to the relevant department. Answering the Telephone for queries/ accepting and entering patient requests onto ASKMYGP for patients without internet access. Accurx online tool Allocation of all requests to GP, FCP, Pharmacists whilst Accurx is operational. SCAN TASKS Processing all tasks in both EMIS and Docman Routine Appointments first contact by letter, second contact by text or phone then complete. Urgent appointments patient to be contacted and booked in. All patient documents to be scanned to notes. Scanning to workflow to be processed when needed due to holiday cover. OTHER DUTIES Filing Summarising Making sure all printers (including Doctors rooms) have adequate paper blood forms and prescriptions. Photocopying general forms and medical records for the purpose of legal documents. Making up Registration Packs. PERSONAL EXTRA ROLE Change of Address Personal Details forms are actioned both on screen and in Paper Medical Records
